from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            minr=min(y for y,x in cells); maxr=max(y for y,x in cells)
            minc=min(x for y,x in cells); maxc=max(x for y,x in cells)
            objs.append((minc,minr,color,cells,maxr-minr+1,maxc-minc+1))
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:(o[0],o[1]))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    r0=c0=0
    for i,(minc,minr,color,cells,oh,ow) in enumerate(objs):
        if i:
            r0 += prevh-1; c0 += prevw-1
        for y,x in cells:
            yy=r0+y-minr; xx=c0+x-minc
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w: out[yy][xx]=color
        prevh,prevw=oh,ow
    return out
